name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key. Created by AI under the directions of the maintainer.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.238: Three changes in what the upload reports. The filename carries the full MD5 of the
    bytes that were sent, between episode and language, so two uploads of the same episode are told
    apart by their content and the hash can be recomputed from the delivered file. The frame rate is
    reported instead of a fixed "unknown" — 0 stays only for rates SubDL does not know, and a broken
    average falls back to the real rate. The docs no longer claim a database engine the plugin
    stopped shipping.
